title: Missions L1–L4 and Harness Studio L2–L4 checked by Playwright on every CI run
user_story: As the owner I want the four L1–L4 workflow flows and the Harness Studio levels tested with Playwright and added to CI/CD (2026-10-28), so a broken flow is caught on every commit, and every defect the tests find is fixed.

requirements.description: autonomy_levels.spec.ts and harness_levels.spec.ts need no model and are selected by routine CI; a Missions UI or autonomy-policy change selects the L1–L4 spec in the pr profile.
Preset agents, AI Architect workflows and visual-runtime reports have English names and texts for the English interface.
Nodes the visual runtime did not execute are never reported as completed; a failed L1–L4 step shows which step failed and why.

nonfunctional: frontend/e2e/autonomy_levels.spec.ts: 5 tests (plans per level and the L4 reproduction rule, L1 step review and failure reason, L2 rejection, L3 coordination without step review, L4 cancellation); the workflows name a model that cannot exist, so model steps fail the same way with or without LM Studio

frontend/e2e/harness_levels.spec.ts: 5 tests (Team, Architect and canvas pass uiAudit in English; L2/L3/L4 architect workflows run control flow and report unexecuted nodes as blocked; no dead mode switch)

Frontend fixes: AutonomyPanel names the failed step and its reason, and no longer flashes 'Enable Research OS' while loading; Harness shows English agent names, architect description and step labels, and hides the mode switch when there is no automated view
outputs: CI browser plan including both specs
postconditions: Every CI run executes the L1–L4 and Harness level specs without a model
acceptance_criteria: The offline CI plan contains both specs

scenarios.expected: Both specs are in the offline-all plan, in the 2D group, and need no model
A README change does not select the L1–L4 spec in the pr profile; a Missions or policy change does
Unexecuted research and agent nodes are reported as not completed, in English
L2, L3 and L4 architect workflows all carry English node names and description
Preset agents always come from code (a saved file cannot replace them) and carry English names

recovery: Fix the defect at its source; never make a model step look executed. TASK-AUTONOMY-QA-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR (D:/qa663) on loopback port 8791, restarted after the backend changes; Chromium headless; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/autonomy-qa-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 6 tests on 49df2d0, 5 failing (the speed check passes on both). GREEN: 6/6. Playwright: first runs 5/5 and 2/5 failed; final 5/5 + 5/5.
